sourceTitle: The British Columbia Gazette, 18 April 1946, volume 86, no 16
creator: Government of British Columbia
noticeDateMeaning: Date on the Department of Education boundary-definition notices. A separate effective legal commencement date is not stated. These are not automatically establishment dates.
noticeContext: Each notice cites section 12(b) of the Public Schools Act as re-enacted by section 8 of the 1946 Amendment Act, and states that the Council of Public Instruction has been pleased to define the named numbered district boundaries.
legalAuthorityLocator: Public Schools Act Amendment Act1946, chapter 64, section 8 (printed pp 239–240); section 121 (printed p278) provides for commencement by proclamation.
numberReuseWarning: Historical district number is not a stable identifier across incarnations. Do not join this roster to current districts by number alone: among reused numbers are5Creston,6 KootenayLake,8 Slocan,20 SalmonArm,67 Ladysmith,73 AlertBay and74Quatsino.
